candidate_mechanism.name: aggressive-flow maker protection
candidate_mechanism.claim: Strong aggressive order flow against proposed maker inventory predicts incremental short-horizon adverse selection.

frozen_signal.imbalance_formula: signed aggressive notional / total aggressive notional
frozen_signal.trigger: imbalance <= -0.75 relative to proposed maker inventory direction

frozen_primary_outcome.price_measure: first same-aggressor-side public market print at or after target
frozen_primary_outcome.markout_sign: positive means movement in maker inventory direction
frozen_primary_outcome.comparison: flagged maker opportunity minus matched unflagged maker opportunity

prospective_data_design.selection: all eligible MLB moneyline games, not windows selected around RN1 activity

confirmatory_sample.stop_rule: evaluate only after target games are complete; do not stop early for performance

confirmatory_success_rule.strong_confirmation: market-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound for primary market-equal difference < 0

prohibited_changes_before_confirmatory_r: size filtering based on OOS performance

execution_boundary.next_stage_if_confirmed: paired protected-vs-unprotected shadow maker replay using authoritative CLOB depth, queue state, cancellation latency, tick size, minimum order size and actual market-specific fee/rebate configuration
